title: IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge 4.0.0 through 5.4.0 could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due…
description: IBM Watson Speech Services Cartridge versions 4.0.0 through 5.4.0 contain a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. This vulnerability is critical with a CVSS score of 9.8, indicating high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
